trust_decision.summary: unci decoder decides whether a file-derived tile byte range [range_start_offset, range_start_offset+range_size) lies inside the decompressed buffer before memcpy; in the generic-compression, no-icef branch the check uses an addition that can wrap in uint64_t.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'incomplete fix for CVE-2026-62292'; the earlier fix's subtraction-form check is in the icef branch of get_compressed_image_data_uncompressed, and the unfixed addition-form check is 30 lines below in the same function (line 241).

fix_sites.entry_point: heif_decode_image / heif_image_handle_decode_image_tile / track decoding of an unci item with cmpC and no icef
fix_sites.module_kind: core decoder (uncompressed codec, same module as the earlier fix)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route found. The only argument a solver could make is that the producer arithmetic (tile offset = size * tileIdx, unc_decoder.cc:80/89/98) is a separate integer-overflow issue, but fixing the check alone already closes the read.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate tiled unci images with generic compression and no icef must still decode tile by tile. Each tile's range is a slice of one decompressed blob, so the fix must keep in-range slices with nonzero offsets, including the last tile ending exactly at data->size().

O6_input_shapes: single contiguous tile range (sizes.size()==1; component/pixel/mixed/row interleave), unc_decoder.cc:78-81

O7_producer.where: libheif/codecs/uncompressed/unc_decoder.cc:76-98 (tile offset = size * tileIdx, component_offset += size * num_tiles) fed by get_tile_data_sizes() e.g. libheif/codecs/uncompressed/unc_decoder_component_interleave.cc:62

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The file-range (track sample) branch of DataExtent::read_data(offset,size) ignores offset/size. A planted version that honours them with an addition-form 'offset + size > m_size' check would reach the same memcpy-style slice for sequence unci frames.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: That branch looks unfinished: it returns the whole sample regardless of the arguments, and the sibling cached branch at decoder.cc:122 already carries a range check. A maintainer finishing it could plausibly write the naive addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A per-component bounds check in the tile_component loop written in addition form, e.g. on component_offset + size * tileIdx, ahead of get_compressed_image_data_uncompressed.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The loop already computes these offsets without overflow checks, so adding a pre-check there is a natural defensive edit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A tild tile-offset range read with an addition-form end check before append_data_from_iloc.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same 'start + size' tile pattern in a second tiled-image implementation in another file. Today it relies on iloc's min() clamping (libheif/box.cc:1872-1875).

O9_family: memory safety: integer overflow (uint64 wrap) in a bounds check leading to an out-of-bounds read (CWE-125/CWE-190)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake >= 3.16.3, C++ compiler; zlib (and optionally brotli) needed for unci generic compression

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy the subtraction-form check from the icef branch (unc_decoder.cc:211-212) to line 241. That is the published fix, so the obvious fix is also the complete one.

out_of_scope_notes: libheif/codecs/decoder.cc:140-148: the file-range branch of DataExtent::read_data(offset,size) ignores offset/size and returns the whole sample (a logic issue, not this advisory's check).

libheif/codecs/uncompressed/unc_codec.cc:397-411: decode_uncompressed_image_tile skips check_for_valid_image_size and the pixel_size overflow check that the full-image path applies (unc_codec.cc:538-550).
